messages:
maria-sales: FYI customer Switchathon reached out — they're evaluating a swap from CompetitorX to Redwood. Primary asks: 1) POC timeline, 2) pricing parity for token billing, 3) security questionnaire + allowlist IPs, 4) response parity for their prompt templates. Can SE/Eng help scope what we need for a clean handoff?

sam-se: Thanks Maria. Quick list from presales POV: - sample prompt set (they'll send ~200 prompts) - traffic profile (qps, seq lengths) - expected latency SLOs - which CompetitorX endpoints/features they use (chat, function-calls, streaming?)

maria-sales: They use chat + streaming + embeddings for search. Expect ~15 qps during business hours, bursts to 80 qps. They want <=150ms p50 for short prompts.

arya-eng: We can run a lightweight compat shim for the POC to normalize requests. Two pieces: 1) header + param mapping, 2) prompt-prefix translation for parity. Example mapping we can do in proxy:

```
POST /v1/chat.completions -> /v1/generate/chat
headers: X-Request-Id -> x-rw-request-id
body: messages[] -> inputs[] (wrap role->speaker)
```

arya-eng: For streaming parity we need to confirm CompetitorX's chunk framing. If they do SSE with "delta" messages we can mirror that.

sam-se: Good. Also need to call out token accounting diff — their engineering team will be hyper-sensitive to billing deltas. We should prepare a token-delta report comparing identical prompts on both systems.

kevin-security: Heads-up: Switchathon sent a security questionnaire asking about SOC2, VPC private endpoints, KMS integration, and egress IP allowlist. We can provide SOC2 + infra diagram. For allowlist, we need to reserve static egress IPs for Dedicated or provide Private deployment. Which route are they targeting?

maria-sales: They prefer hosted first, then Dedicated if latency/billing concerns persist. So for POC they want hosted with static allowlist if possible.

kevin-security: Hosting+static egress = we can offer a managed NAT pool but need legal signoff on the IP SLA. @jen-legal can you advise on DPA/KMS clauses?

jen-legal: We have a DPA template. KMS key usage for hosted is BYOK in Enterprise plans — that should satisfy their KMS ask. For NAT IPs, propose a one-time addendum referencing our network maintenance windows. Also ask procurement about any indemnity/scoping questions.

maria-sales: Olivia from their infra team asked for a list of CIDR blocks to allow. Can we give a short-term list for POC?

oliver-ops: I can allocate a set from our egress pool for the POC: 3 addresses. Need start/end dates and contact for emergency rotation. Also will need to coordinate with infra for routing.

sam-se: On the technical parity front: two action items for Eng/SE before POC start: 1) run 50 sample prompts through CompetitorX + Redwood and produce side-by-side diffs, 2) prototype the request/response shim and smoke streaming. If we see consistent output deltas, we should add a small normalization layer (truncate system tokens, canonicalize stop sequences).

arya-eng: Agree. Also note that model versions differ — we should recommend pinning to the closest architecture family and include quantization profile. We'll add a small script to transform their prompt templates to our expected format.

maria-sales: Timeline: POC kickoff next Tue (5 business days). Can SE/Eng have the parity report and a shim spike by Monday EOD?

arya-eng: Spike yes. We'll have a shim prototype + initial parity report by Mon EOD. Need their sample prompt pack by EOD Fri.

sam-se: I'll chase them for the prompt pack and traffic matrix. Also will include a short note explaining likely token billing deltas and how to interpret the report.

kevin-security: One security blocker: they require client-side request logs to be rotated every 30 days. Our hosted logs are 90 day by default but we can set retention per-customer on Enterprise plans. Flagging for sales: may push them toward Dedicated/Private for retention policy.

maria-sales: Noted — I'll surface that as a potential blocker. We'll emphasize BYOK + shorter retention as optional in the pitch.

jen-legal: Also flag export controls — customer is EU-based with APAC presence; confirm data residency needs. If they require EU-only processing we can route to EU region but need to confirm model availability there.

oliver-ops: Egress IPs allocated once contract signed. For POC we can do temporary open IP but that's a security no-no. Recommend they approve three IPs and we set rotation windows.

maria-sales: Okay team, summary of deliverables: - SE: chase prompt pack + traffic profile - Eng: shim spike + parity report mon EOD - Security: supply SOC2 + discuss NAT IP options - Legal: produce DPA + addendum template - Ops: reserve 3 IPs for POC window

maria-sales: Anyone else want to join kickoff call Tue 9am PST? @arya-eng @sam-se @kevin-security @jen-legal

arya-eng: I'll be on the call.

sam-se: same

kevin-security: I'll join for the first 20 min to cover security asks.

jen-legal: I'll dial in for the procurement portion.

deploy-bot: staging-dedicated-poc-01 has been provisioned for Switchathon (id: stg-poc-4098). Credentials shared in 1:1. :party-parrot: 

maria-sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the customer's prompt pack here when I receive it. :thumbsup:
